executable_actions.on_failure: Retry the current parameter_binding stage for any framework/hash/provenance/route failure without rewinding design stages; if code_generation_manifest_static_check fails, block RTL generation until the stage-input/manifest contract is corrected.
executable_actions.rationale: parameter_binding static checks passed 6/6, the stage command returned 0, and SACG memory truth shows zero active blockers. Promote the validated selected architecture into code generation while preserving DSE exact measurement as downstream.

executable_actions.on_failure: Record actual synthesis failure or implementation infeasibility in dse_measurements.jsonl; do not modify candidate parameters or claim QoR/hardware pass; advance to the next supplied unmeasured legal candidate unless the deterministic evaluator flags legality, and raise a bounded backtrack request only if a cited hardware-design failure category with linked tool evidence applies.
executable_actions.rationale: The formal DSE campaign remains incomplete and the selected legal candidate requires exact target-board app-shell synthesis measurement. Queue this real tool action for backend_board after code generation and board-accurate wrapper availability; it is not a current parameter_binding blocker and must not become a QoR or hardware-pass claim.

The qor_estimator status is insufficient_evidence and its validation sample_count is insufficient_independent_samples; ranking is not QoR evidence.
materialized_refill_rate_contract passes with cache_refill_data_width_bits=512, derived from the board AXI data width.
AXI transfer layout checks are static alignment/packing checks only; they are not bandwidth, timing, power, or throughput evidence.
LLM planning is mandatory and satisfied with requested model deepseek-v4-pro.
No sub-agent role_assignment or stage_gate_policy was supplied in this flow-controller review slice, so no specialist-boundary conflict is inferred.
proposed_actions: Proceed to code_generation using the validated selected architecture arch_08fc81fe6157.
Record the parameter-binding promotion in SACG memory and carry forward the downstream DSE exact target-board app-shell measurement obligation.
Run code-generation manifest/static checks before RTL generation and keep the candidate parameters immutable.
Defer real Vivado synthesis/resource/timing measurement to backend_board after board-accurate RTL is available.
If a future measurement fails with linked tool evidence in an allowed hardware-design failure category, raise a bounded backtrack request instead of silently retrying or modifying the candidate.
risks: Actual Vivado resource usage, timing, and derived throughput for arch_08fc81fe6157 remain unknown; downstream backend measurement may still prove resource/implementation infeasible.
The calibrated estimator has insufficient independent validation, so the selected candidate's rank must not be treated as quality-of-result evidence.

DSE exact measurement is pending; if the candidate later fails with cited resource/timing evidence, the flow may need a bounded design backtrack under an allowed hardware-design failure category, but no such backtrack is authorized now.
Code generation must preserve the chosen numeric policy and board AXI/DDR facts; cross-layer inconsistencies in data width, alignment, or stream order would become downstream blockers.
clock_target_mhz is currently null, so no timing objective is bound yet; this is a later backend timing concern, not a current parameter-binding blocker.
The DUT scope excludes embedding/tokenization, final model norm, LM head/logits, and sampling; code generation and golden boundaries must not expand that scope.
The selected candidate is an LLM measurement-order choice, not deterministic Pareto-final evidence; downstream stages must not overstate its status.
